subject: Integration follow-up — API auth, key lifecycle, routing for embeddings & tools
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gupta <alex.gupta@ledgerpoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood follow-up — auth & key lifecycle (post-demo)

Hi Alex — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side: 

Recap (30-min demo):
- Covered Redwood hosted API, Dedicated options, and private deployment patterns.
- Walked through sample invoice-processing flow (embedding + reranker + structured outputs via tool-calling).
- Flagged your main concerns: (1) auth/key lifecycle, (2) embedding PII handling and retention, (3) routing between high-cost low-latency vs. low-cost high-throughput models.

Technical asks / info we need from you:
1) Preferred auth model: API keys (long-lived), OAuth2 client-credentials (short-lived JWTs), or service accounts managed by you?
2) Where will you store signing keys / JWKs — Okta, AWS KMS, GCP KMS, HSM?
3) Do you require customer-managed key rotation cadence (e.g., 30/90 days) or can we use short-lived tokens and rotate at our edge?
4) Embedding retention policy — do we need to purge embeddings after X days or never store embeddings on our side?

Suggested near-term plan:
- Technical deep-dive (45 min): cover SDK setup, recommended OAuth2 flow, routing rules for reranker vs. embeddings, structured output/tool-calling security constraints.
- Deliverable: integration checklist + recommended auth patterns (attached).

Proposed times: Tue 2027-10-05 10:00-10:45 PT or Wed 2027-10-06 14:00-14:45 PT — let me know what works.

Attachment: redwood-integration-primer.pdf (one-pager), auth-checklist.xlsx (questions & templates).

High-level recommendation (for discussion):
- For server-to-server traffic, prefer OAuth2 client_credentials issuing short-lived JWTs (1-15m) backed by your Okta / customer KMS; Redwood validates via JWKS. This minimizes blast radius vs. long-lived API keys.
- If you need machine-to-machine simplicity for a POC, scoped API keys with strict IP or VPC restrictions and a short rotation window are acceptable.
- For Dedicated / Private customers we support customer-managed KMS and hardware-backed key storage for signing tokens.

Next steps (owner):
- Alex: confirm preferred auth approach and whether security team wants a separate scoping call.
- Irene: run deep-dive + invite SE and Solutions engineer (Marissa).

Thanks — I’ll hold the proposed slots until EOD tomorrow.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

From: Alex Gupta <alex.gupta@ledgerpoint.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@ledgerpoint.com
Date: 2027-10-03T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood follow-up — auth & key lifecycle (post-demo)

Thanks, Irene — great session. A few quick answers and clarifications: 

- Preferred auth model: we prefer OAuth2 client_credentials (Okta) for server-to-server. We'd like Redwood to validate JWTs against our Okta JWKS endpoint.
- Key storage: Okta will be the source of truth for JWKs. We can provide the JWKS URL (attaching current dump).
- Rotation policy: security wants rotating signing keys, cadence 90 days for now, but they'd like short-lived tokens too. So a combined approach (rotate signing keys + short-lived access tokens) is ideal.
- Embedding retention: legal wants embeddings to be retained for 180 days, then purged. Also need an option to disable embeddings retention altogether for certain tenants.

We can do Wed 2027-10-06 14:00 PT for the deep-dive. Please include Marissa for implementation details and Ben for routing discussion.

Attaching: okta-jwks.json (current public keys).

Also, two security asks:
1) Can Redwood provide a short write-up showing how key rollover looks end-to-end (token issuance, verification, and rotation)?
2) For embeddings, confirm data-at-rest encryption and whether embeddings stored encrypted with customer KMS is possible for Private/Dedicated deployments.

— Alex
Alex Gupta
Head of Platform Integrations, LedgerPoint
alex.gupta@ledgerpoint.com
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gupta <alex.gupta@ledgerpoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood follow-up — auth & key lifecycle (post-demo)

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmation, Alex. Wed 2027-10-06 14:00 PT is booked. Agenda for the 45-min deep-dive: 

1) 10m — Auth model choice & token flow (Irene + Marissa)
2) 10m — Key rotation patterns and end-to-end rollover walkthrough (Ben)
3) 10m — SDK setup for OAuth2 client_credentials + JWKS validation (Marissa)
4) 10m — Routing: embeddings vs. reranker model selection & structured output/tool-calling constraints (Ben)
5) 5m — Next steps / action items

Pre-reads / deliverables we’ll bring:
- Short write-up: key rollover (will share during the call).
- Implementation sample: SDK code snippet for client_credentials + automatic JWKS refresh.
- Routing pattern suggestions for low-latency vs. cost-optimized paths.

Security replies to your asks:
- Embeddings retention for hosted customers: we support configurable retention windows; can be set to 0 to disable retention. For Dedicated/Private, we can enable customer-managed encryption keys (CMK) so embeddings at rest are encrypted with your KMS.
- We’ll produce a concise end-to-end key rollover doc ahead of the meeting (Ben will draft).

Action items:
- Alex: add any security-specific constraints or an excerpt of your embedding retention policy to the HubSpot record (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4521).
- Marissa: share SDK examples and a shortest-path POC checklist.
- Ben: draft key-rollover write-up and a recommended rotation cadence matrix (short-lived token + 90d signing key ok).

I’ll send the calendar invite with a Meet link and attach the two documents mentioned earlier. If security prefers a separate scoping call, we can add a follow-up block for Oct 8.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Irene
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142
